confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, pypdf fallback extraction, rendered figure/methods pages, and the downloaded supplement DOC/text extraction were checked. Exp. 2 trajectory geometry, apparatus, speed, tactile setup, trial families, ITI, repetitions, and total counts are extractable. Remaining uncertainty concerns the exact 16-speaker waveform/source asset, exact gain/SPL law, the 13-versus-14 distance wording discrepancy, exact baseline timings, block structure, and response timeout.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: Experiment 2 can be recreated as a trunk-centered front/back 16-speaker or renderer-emulated moving-sound profile: dynamic sounds traverse 1 m in front to 1 m behind the standing participant, or the reverse, at 35 cm/s while tactile targets are delivered to sternum/back sites. Exact original acoustic waveform, intensity field, baseline timing schedule, and block/order rules would need approximation.

orientation_ledger.participant_frame: Participants stood halfway down the 16-speaker array; explicit gaze/facing direction is not reported beyond author front/back body labels.
orientation_ledger.room_apparatus_frame: Two arrays of eight speakers formed a 2 m longitudinal front-back layout, with each array 50 cm from participant midline in the horizontal plane.
orientation_ledger.body_relative_mapping: Authors label the sampled space as participant front or back; sounds began 1 m in front or 1 m behind and terminated 1 m in the opposite space.
orientation_ledger.tactile_anchor: Two vibrotactors on the trunk, one at sternum level and one at equivalent elevation on the back.
orientation_ledger.movement_implementation: Physical 16-speaker array with speaker intensities modulated over time; full source movement is implemented by an intensity field rather than a moving loudspeaker.
orientation_ledger.evidence_class: Text-reported in main PDF methods/results plus Figure 1/caption visual geometry; supplement extraction did not add reliable 16-speaker waveform details.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 2-4 for Experiment 2 and Figure 1; pages 11-13 for tactile apparatus, acoustic stimuli, procedure, design, counts, table, and ITI.
Used as primary extracted text map for targeted five-pass searches, then checked against rendered pages and fallback extraction.
Visual inspection of Figure 1 lower-left/lower-right panels for the 16-speaker array, front/back axis, and 2 m layout.
Supplement was available locally; targeted searches found useful 2-speaker validation/provenance but no reliable 16-speaker waveform details in extracted text.
Searched for 16-speaker, array, front/back, validation, SoundForge, pink noise, SPL, and speaker-setup terms.
Printed targeted snippets from pages 2, 3, 11, 12, and 13 to verify Exp. 2 separation from other experiments.
Temporary rendered pages checked for visual geometry, methods wording, and design/count paragraphs; page images were not committed.

review_attempts.result: Mapped 20/25 auto-mined candidate fields and exposed mixed candidates from multiple experiments that required manual isolation.
Isolated Exp. 2 from the seven-experiment paper: 16-speaker front/back trunk setup, 35 cm/s movement, front-to-back/back-to-front trajectories, and trunk tactile anchors.
Rendered the Exp. 2/Figure 1 pages and inspected the extracted figure image; recorded the participant-array-body mapping in the orientation ledger.
pypdf snippets from pages 2, 11, 12, and 13 confirmed the Exp. 2 distances, 16-speaker array, tactile apparatus, response rule, count formula, and ITI.
Local supplement DOC/text was searched for 16-speaker, array, validation, pink-noise, SPL, and SoundForge terms; only 2-speaker provenance was reliably exposed.

review_attempts.strategy: Trial sequence, baseline, catch, and count pass
review_attempts.result: Identified three trial families, 20% tactile-only baseline logic, auditory-only catches, 500-700 ms randomly shuffled ITI, 12 repetitions, 372 total trials, and derived 36 baseline/24 catch counts.
Preserved the discrepancy between prose reporting 14 delays/front-back distances and the design formula using 13 multisensory distances rather than silently normalizing it.

stimulus_type.value: Dynamic auditory stimuli; likely noise-based by paradigm/supplement context, but the exact 16-speaker Exp. 2 waveform is not directly reported.
stimulus_type.page_or_section: PDF pp.11-12, Acoustic Stimuli; supplement 2-speaker setup
stimulus_type.evidence_note: Main text reports dynamic sounds and a 16-speaker setup; supplement exposes pink-noise provenance only for the 2-speaker setup.

source_provenance.page_or_section: PDF pp.11-13; supplement searched for 16-speaker provenance
source_provenance.evidence_note: No exact Exp. 2 source WAV, noise seed, or generation script was found after PDF, supplement, fallback, and figure checks.

trajectory_count.value: Two dynamic traversal directions: front-to-back and back-to-front; analysis also separates body-relative looming versus receding halves.
trajectory_count.page_or_section: PDF pp.2, 11-12, Experiment 2 and Acoustic Stimuli
trajectory_count.evidence_note: Sounds started 1 m in front or back and terminated at the opposite far location.

trajectory_path.value: Participants stood midway in a 2 m front-back 16-speaker array; sounds moved from 1 m front to 1 m back or the reverse, sampled at 5-95 cm in front/back space.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Figure/caption add the two 8-speaker arrays, 2 m longitudinal distance, and 50 cm lateral array spacing.

stimulus_duration.value: Full front-back traversal duration is about 5.71 s from 2 m path length at 35 cm/s; each 1 m approach/recede half is about 2.86 s.
stimulus_duration.page_or_section: PDF pp.2, 11, Experiment 2 and Acoustic Stimuli
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Derived from reported 2 m layout and 35 cm/s velocity; no standalone audio-file duration was reported.

stimulus_speed.value: The 16-speaker setup produced Exp. 2 dynamic sounds moving at 35 cm/s.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: This separates Exp. 2 from 22 cm/s two-speaker experiments and 25 cm/s Exp. 6.

auditory_conditions.value: Front/back mapping space and looming/receding sound direction were analyzed; sounds could start in front or back and pass the body.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: ANOVA used Mapping Space Front vs Back and Sound Direction Looming vs Receding.

gain_envelope.value: Speaker intensities in the 16-speaker array were modulated as a function of time; exact gain law and SPL endpoints for Exp. 2 are not reported.
gain_envelope.page_or_section: PDF p.3 Figure 1 caption; p.11 Acoustic Stimuli
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Qualitative intensity-field implementation is reported, but not the numeric envelope.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Physical 16-speaker setup: two arrays of eight speakers, 2 m longitudinal front-back span, 50 cm from participant midline to each array.
renderer_or_apparatus.page_or_section: PDF p.3 Figure 1 caption; p.11 Acoustic Stimuli
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Participant stood halfway down the array for Exp. 2.

trial_rows_families.value: Three trial families: bimodal audio-tactile trials, tactile-only baseline trials, and auditory-only catch/no-go trials.
trial_rows_families.page_or_section: PDF p.12, General Procedure and Design and Analysis
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: All experiments used the same three broad trial types.

condition_intermixing.value: Exp. 2 rows appear intermixed within a single 372-trial task formula; no separate blocked phases are described.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: Derived from the combined formula; exact randomization/order algorithm is not specified.

blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: No explicit block count, trial-order algorithm, or randomization rule beyond ITI shuffling was found.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Inter-trial intervals were randomly shuffled between 500 and 700 ms.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: Reported as a general rule after the experiment-specific trial-count formulas.

response_window.evidence_note: XBOX button response is reported, but no explicit response timeout/window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants responded rapidly to tactile vibration, treated sounds as task-irrelevant, and withheld responses on sound-only catch trials.
task_sequence_rules.page_or_section: PDF p.12, General Procedure and Design and Analysis
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: The task rule is stated in the general procedure.

tactile_stimulus.value: Two Precision MicroDrives 312-101 150 Hz vibration motors on sternum and back; stimulation lasted 100 ms.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Methods also report 3 V, 60 mA, 9000 rpm, 5 g, 113 mm2 surface area, and 50 ms spin-up.

soa_table.value: Distance-at-touch values are reported as 5, 20, 35, 50, 65, 80, and 95 cm in both front and back space; design formula uses 13 distances.
soa_table.page_or_section: PDF pp.2, 12, Experiment 2 and Design and Analysis
soa_table.evidence_note: Prose says one of 14 delays, while the formula says 13 multisensory distances; exact temporal SOA table is not printed.

baseline_strategy.value: Tactile-only unimodal baseline trials without sound; fastest baseline condition was subtracted from audio-tactile RTs.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Baseline correction strategy is explicitly described for all experiments.

baseline_timing.evidence_note: Exp. 2 formula reports 3 baselines, but exact timing/delay identities for those three baseline rows were not resolved.

catch_trial_type.value: Auditory-only catch trials: sound presented without tactile stimulation, with response withholding required.
catch_trial_type.page_or_section: PDF p.12, Design and Analysis; Table 1
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Exp. 2 Table 1 reports catch accuracy for looming and receding conditions.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Exp. 2 formula: [13 multisensory distances x 2 sound directions + 3 baselines + 2 catch trials] x 12 repetitions.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: Thus each multisensory distance x direction cell has 12 repetitions.

baseline_count.value: Three baseline rows x 12 repetitions = 36 tactile-only baseline trials.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Count is derived directly from the reported Exp. 2 formula.

catch_count.value: Two catch rows x 12 repetitions = 24 auditory-only catch trials.
catch_count.page_or_section: PDF p.12, Design and Analysis; Table 1
catch_count.evidence_note: Count is derived from the reported Exp. 2 formula; Table 1 separates looming/receding catch accuracy.

block_count.evidence_note: The experiments never exceeded 60 minutes, but no Exp. 2 block/session count was found.

total_trial_count.evidence_note: The total is explicitly reported with the Exp. 2 formula.

critical_caveats: Exact 16-speaker waveform/source asset, noise seed, or stimulus file is not reported.
Pink-noise provenance is exposed for the 2-speaker setup in the supplement but not directly for the Exp. 2 16-speaker setup.
Exact intensity/gain law and SPL calibration for the 16-speaker array are not reported beyond time-varying speaker-intensity modulation.
Main prose says 14 delays/distances in Exp. 2, whereas the design formula uses 13 multisensory distances.
Exact temporal SOA milliseconds and the identities of the three baseline timings are not printed.
Exact trial-order randomization, block count, and response timeout/window are not reported.
Participant-facing/gaze direction is not explicitly stated, so body-relative front/back mapping should follow the authors' front/back labels and Figure 1.
next_manual_action: Strong candidate for a toolkit recreation as a renderer-emulated or multi-source 16-speaker front/back trunk profile, with the waveform, gain field, baseline timing, and 13/14 distance ambiguity documented as approximations unless author materials become available.
